queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Examination E
  INNER JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
  GROUP BY P.SEX
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS total, AVG(cnt) AS mean_cnt FROM g
)
SELECT
  SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count,
  AVG(g.cnt / t.total) AS avg_share,
  AVG(g.cnt - t.mean_cnt) AS avg_diff
FROM g, t
WHERE g.cnt > t.mean_cnt;
SELECT CAST(COUNT(E.ID) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SEX) FROM Patient) FROM Examination E JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
GROUP BY SEX
HAVING COUNT(*) > (
    SELECT AVG(c)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM Patient
        WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(SEX) <> ''
        GROUP BY SEX
    )
);
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgA` >= (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);
